match_confirmation.by_campaigns: Campaign set is agency self-promotion / lead-gen ('PPC Guru Leads Ads', 'PPC Guru - British Columbia', 'PPC Guru All Services', plus test campaigns 'Dentist USA')

detected_history: Two eras: (1) 2024 pilot Jun-Oct 2024 (small budget, instant-form leads); account then paused Nov 2024 - Feb 2026; (2) 2026 scale-up Mar-Jul 2026, mixing messaging-conversation and instant-form campaigns, with instant-form lead volume ramping from May 2026.
notes: Genuine lead metric = 'lead' (instant-form submissions), the clean countable signal. Account-level 'results' returns 'Not available' every month because results were aggregated across different attribution settings (mixed objectives), so results.value cannot be used at account level. Some 2026 months (Mar, Apr) show lead 'Not available' because those months ran messaging-conversation campaigns rather than instant-form campaigns; instant-form lead volume scales from May 2026. This is the agency's OWN account, so there is a genuine earlier baseline (2024 pilot) — treated as Method A/B hybrid: 'then' = first complete pilot month (Jul 2024), 'now' = most recent complete month (Jul 2026). A ~16-month pause (Nov 2024-Feb 2026) sits between the eras and is disclosed. Values are formatted strings and were parsed to numbers; amount_spent_cents used where present.
